recap.text: Oozy Form scurries out of Donut's mailbox on little legs, and the cleaner bot drops it in Carl's arms, where it spews slime down his shirt. Donut prefers her Smoke Form, so Carl grasps it in both hands and learns it. He uses it first to swap a bugbear's peach-flavoured beer for a can rigged with explosive, then clicks Detonate, and Team Free Love dies.

beats.headline: A book with legs
beats.text: Donut has opened the little door of the mailbox when a spell book scurries out, trailing slime, rushes across the room like an escaped rat and bangs against the kitchen cabinets. Mordecai shouts to catch it: they can break if they injure themselves. The cleaner bot swoops on it and drops it in Carl's arms, where it wriggles on its little legs and spews slime down his shirt. Oozy Form. With an O, like slimy: you turn into a slime. Mordecai calls it great, a special edition that trains faster, but warns him to be somewhere safe when it runs out; only at level 15 can he stay in it indefinitely. Donut is never going to use it.
beats.gist: Donut opens the mailbox and a slimy spell book scurries out; Carl catches it.

beats.headline: Applied in both hands
beats.text: Donut gives the ooze a suspicious sniff. Her Smoke Form, from her new class, is better, a Phase-style spell, so Carl should take this one. Mordecai agrees: Carl's Gloom Wraith Phase is an attack and forces him in a direction, so it is no use for travel, and with this both of them can slip through and around obstacles. The spell book squeals and squirts more goo, and the cleaner bot complains. Sorry, says Carl, and grasps it in both hands and applies it, learning Oozy Form.
beats.gist: Carl takes the Oozy Form spell book because Donut's Smoke Form is better, and he learns it.

beats.headline: A beer in the cul-de-sac
beats.text: Forgive me, friends, Carl whispers, and clicks Detonate. Team Free Love is eliminated, both racers dead. The bomb went in at the cul-de-sac. Samantha rolled in to distract the two bugbears while Carl used his Oozy Form spell for the first time, slid up and replaced one of their peach-flavoured beers with the can they had given him, drilled out and fitted with a hidden explosive he built in his bomber's studio. Their magical cooler teleports back into their van after every race.
beats.gist: Carl detonates a bomb hidden in a beer can, killing both racers of Team Free Love.

beats.headline: Through the centipede's organs
beats.text: Inside Scolopendra they land in a massive chamber with a slippery, stinking floor, and on the map the outer wall of the club is perhaps fifty metres away. Carl casts Oozy Form. Splatch. He has done this only once before. He loses his eyes and his ears, his vision is suddenly all around him, and he can see perfectly in the dark. Thanks to the magic of the carrier, Penelope is part of him too. He slimes toward the building wall over and around giant pulsing organs, forty seconds before the next attack.
beats.gist: Carl casts Oozy Form inside Scolopendra, loses his eyes and ears, and slimes toward the wall with Penelope.
